name: solid-v2-codemod
description: Analyze and safely transform supported Solid 2 migration sites

scripts.test: pnpm test:architecture && pnpm test:report && pnpm test:rules && pnpm test:workflow
scripts.test:rules: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 jssg test -l tsx ./rules/imports/web-import.test.ts ./rules/imports/__testfixtures__ --strictness strict && pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 jssg test -l tsx ./rules/reactivity/create-effect.test.ts ./rules/reactivity/__testfixtures__ --strictness strict --semantic-workspace
scripts.validate: pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 workflow validate -w workflow.yaml && pnpm dlx codemod@1.12.13 workflow validate -w workflow.transform.yaml
scripts.verify: pnpm test && pnpm check-types && pnpm validate
